pages.text: $(item)Clackers$() boost Hamon damage while held. Swing to throw them, hold use to spin them.

Caesar Zeppeli's gloves. Wear them to use $(move)Bubble Launcher$() and $(move)Bubble Cutter$().$(br2)Rarely found in $(l:world/ruins)ancient ruins$(). $(l:world/willow)Willow$() may sell a pair once she knows you.
Made of beetle silk, which conducts Hamon. Wear it to use $(move)Snake Muffler$().$(br2)Rarely found in $(l:world/ruins)ancient ruins$(). Willow may sell one once she trusts you fully.
Gloves and scarves are accessories. Wear them in the slots of the panel beside your inventory, opened by the glove button.
